[SERVICE DOMAIN: Payment Orchestration] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
DERIVACION Functional Pattern : Process Asset Type : Payment Orchestration Generic Artifact : Procedure Control Record : Payment Orchestration Details (Asset Type + Generic Artifact)
UBICACION MATRIX Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Payments
BUSINESS DEFINITION Orquesta la ejecucion de la instruccion de pago: invoca las comprobaciones previas, determina y cobra comisiones, enruta de forma inteligente por el esquema de pago adecuado, cursa la instruccion por el rail elegido, sigue la finalizacion del pago, atiende devoluciones y rechazos, e inicia el movimiento final de fondos.
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (6) Initiate Payment Confirmation Fee Transfer Payment Routing Payment Rail Coordination Initiate Payment Settlement Payment Initiation (for RTP)
